items:
We are thrilled to welcome you to "My Second Wind" - our home away from home and a true resort vacation destination!

We think we are the PERFECT place for a quiet weekend get away, a group tennis/golf weekend or a family friendly beach vacation!

Our gorgeous 4 bedroom waterfront cottage is located in “Fairmont Heritage Inspiration by the Bay” within the Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort. A boutique neighborhood nestled in the magnolia and pine trees between the Choctawhatchee Bay and the Burnt Pine Golf Course, Inspiration by the Bay, offers our guests the privacy and amenities of a luxury hotel, plus access to all of the fun and excitement that the Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort has to offer! Spanning more then 2400 acres, Sandestin has something for everyone - Family friendly Village of Baytown Wharf with games, amusements , live music and events, 4 championship golf courses, the Sandestin Golf Academy, a 98 slip marina, watersports, world class tennis center w/15 tennis courts & active tennis and pickle ball programs and private resort beach access. Looking for something more sophisticated? Make sure to check out Sandestin's newest destination Hotel Effie... a luxurious full service hotel complete with both casual and fine dining options, spectacular new spa and rooftop pool and lounge!

"My Second Wind" is not managed by a rental company... so you are our #1 priority! Our caretaker Jared, housekeeper Amie, myself or my husband are only a text or phone call away.... so if there is anything we can do or if there is anything you need during your stay, please don't hesitate to let us know!

“My Second Wind” COTTAGE AMENITIES

Just a few steps from the pool and Heritage Place private Residence Clubhouse, you will find "My Second Wind". This charming, newly remodeled cottage has been re-designed and re-decorated with your comfort and stay in mind! We have filled the cottage with all of our favorite "vacation things” and are continually adding and updating... We want you to have every single thing you need for a stress free vacation stay and we hope that you’ll agree, “My Second Wind” ... is the perfect place for you to call your "vacation home”!

- Pack less and play more with our fully stocked beach closets. We have toys, boogie boards, beach toys, beach chairs, beach umbrellas and coolers already provided for you!
- Brand new EVERYTHING by professional interior designer in 2019, 2020, 2021, 2023 & 2024
- Stunning kitchen remodel with built in bar and wine fridge
- Luxury Chef’s kitchen complete with VIKING appliances, Williams Sonoma utensils, pots/pans, and dishes; Henckels Knife Set, upgraded luxury espresso machine, blender, toaster, Panini press, waffle iron, KEURIG coffee machine with assorted coffees and teas.
- Spacious living area with 65 inch smart TV, cozy fireplace, french doors opening out to the HUGE 1st floor screen porch and GORGEOUS views of the Choctawhatchee Bay.
- 1st floor screened-in porch complete with oversized gas grill, 55 inch TV, outdoor dining w/stunning bay and golf course views.
- Bedroom #1: 1st Floor King suite w/55-inch smart TV and private spa bath.
- Bedroom #2: 2nd Floor King suite w/ with 65 inch TV, private spa bath and screen porch, complete w/swing to enjoy AMAZING sunsets!
- Bedroom #3: Stunning Queen bedroom with vaulted ceilings 65 inch smart TV and French doors to 2nd floor screen porch with daybed swing and comfy outdoor living spaces – perfect for morning coffee and afternoon napping!
- Bedroom #4: HUGE bunk room w/ 3 Twin bunks, 1 Double bunk, 75" smart TV w/XBOX

****Please note: to ensure that everyone has the most comfortable stay possible, we have a maximum occupancy of 6 adults and 4 children... the bunk beds are just no fun for grown ups!!!

****Parking Policy: 3-vehicle + 1-golf cart maximum per home OR 2-vehicle + 2-golf cart Essentially, 4 total vehicles per home, including the golf cart(s)

- Hi-speed Internet, premier cable, ON DEMAND, NETFLIX and Apple TV.
- Washer and dryer.
- Iron and ironing board.


**Arriving late? Or don’t want to waste time running errands? Grocery delivery available.


COMPLIMENTARY INSPIRATION CLUB AMENITIES:
- Heated Pool and Hot Tub
- Cushioned loungers
- Fitness/workout facility
- Outdoor kitchen
- Outdoor ping pong table
- Pool toys
- Indoor Entertainment lounge with billiards table, honor bar, coffee and snacks, Big screen TV, Games, movies and books
- Guest Bikes
- Private dock, fishing pier

THE SANDESTIN GOLF AND BEACH RESORT
Centrally located, INSPIRATION at Fairmont Heritage Place is an easy walk or golf cart ride to virtually everything the Sandestin Golf and Beach has to offer:
- Spectacular Emerald Coast Beach with dining, watersports, chair/umbrella set up, lifeguards, sundries and restroom facilities.
- 4 Championship Golf courses.
- The Sandestin Golf Academy.
- Award winning Tennis center with 15 lit, clay courts.
- 98 slip marina with boating and fishing charters available.
- Fishing in 72 stocked lakes.
- Health Club.
- Day Spa and Salon.
- Adult and children sport, educational, and entertainment programs.
- Sandestin’s Baytown Wharf: offering an array of shopping, dining, and entertainment options including dancing & live music, outdoor concerts, zip lining, the tower climb, 18-hole putt- putt course, and children’s activities.
- The Grand Boulevard at Sandestin featuring boutique shopping at retailers like Pottery Barn, Tommy Bahama, and Williams Sonoma. Local eateries like Vintage and Craft Burgers and fine dining at the likes of Flemings and PF Changs. Have a rainy afternoon? No problem, spend the afternoon at the Blvd 10 Cinema Theatre snacking on popcorn and watching the newest in movie releases!

We look forward to welcoming you and your guests to “My Second Wind”. Please feel free to reach out to me with any questions, concerns or for more information about our home or the resort!
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
